newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-AMOKACHI IN TROUBLE FOR VISITING SICK MOTHER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AMOKACHI IN TROUBLE FOR VISITING SICK MOTHER.

text.p: Istanbul's Besiktas will punish Nigerian striker Daniel Amokachi after a trip home to visit his sick mother almost made him miss a key match and left the soccer club with a big bill for hiring a private plane.

According to newspaper reports on Monday, Besiktas spent 11,000 pounds ($17,820) on hiring a plane to bring Amokachi back for the match with Fenerbahce after he missed a flight connection from London.
"The club has its principles and in line with those principles we will punish Amokachi," manager Rasim Kara was quoted as saying by Anatolian news agency.
Besiktas fans at their home stadium cheered rapturously when told over the loudspeakers that Amokachi had arrived half an hour before kick-off.
He put in an under-par performance in the match, which Besiktas, fourth in the Turkish first division and one place behind Fenerbahce, won 1-0.
Amokachi aplogised for his late return from Nigeria.
"My mother is very ill. That was why I was late. I apologise to everyone but I expect understanding," Amokachi was quoted as saying by the Sabah daily.
Amokachi scored in last year's Olympic final to help Nigeria beat Argentina 3-2.
